description: This file defines the LoanRemoveOfficerBusinessEvent class, which represents a specific business event related to removing an officer from a loan in the Fineract system. It extends a base class LoanBusinessEvent and mainly provides a specific event type identifier.

classes.description: A class representing a business event triggered when an officer is removed from a loan, encapsulating the loan details and event type.
